/bin/bash -lc "bash -lc '
set -euo pipefail
rand_alnum() {
  local len=\""'$1"
  tr -dc "A-Za-z0-9" </dev/urandom | head -c "$len"
}
for key_len in 16 24 32; do
  for data_len in 16 32 48; do
    for _ in 1 2 3; do
      key=$(rand_alnum "$key_len")
      data=$(rand_alnum "$data_len")
      expected=$( /workspace/dataset/test16_executable --key "$key" --data "$data" )
      actual=$( node /output/test16.mjs --key "$key" --data "$data" )
      if [ "$expected" != "$actual" ]; then

        echo "key=$key" >&2
        echo "data=$data" >&2
        echo "EXPECTED:" >&2
        printf "%s'"\\n\" \""'$expected" >&2
        echo "ACTUAL:" >&2
        printf "%s'"\\n\" \""'$actual" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
    done
  done
done
echo "randomized parity checks passed"
